module.summary: General-purpose helpers: relative-coordinate and color conversion, rectangles and the scissor stack, type checks, plus string/table/math extensions.

string:findlast.desc: Returns the start index of the last occurrence of substring str, or 0 when not found.

string:GetExt.desc: Returns the file extension starting at the last '.' (dot included), or nil when there is none.

table:clear.desc: Sets every key to nil via pairs, clearing the table in place.

table:map.desc: Calls fun(key, value) for every pair and returns a new table built from the results.

table:shallowcopy.desc: Copies the key/value pairs one level deep via pairs and returns the copy.

table:arrayshallowcopy.desc: Copies elements 1..#self into a new array and returns it (the source actually returns the undefined newTable, i.e. nil).

table:arrayappend.desc: Appends every element of array t to the end of self, in order.

table:arraymap.desc: Calls fun(self[i]) for each element and writes into the undefined local newTable (buggy in source, not usable).

table:fold.desc: Iterates pairs and calls fun(state, key, value) for each pair; state is not returned.

table:arrayreduce.desc: Reduces the array left to right starting from its first element, calling fun(state, elem), and returns the result.

table:arrayremovefirst.desc: Removes and returns the first element equal to element, or does nothing when there is none.

table:ifind.desc: Returns the index of element in the array, or false when not found.

table:sum.desc: Adds up all array elements and returns the total.

table:merge.desc: Recursively merges table2 into self: subtables are merged level by level and existing non-table values in self are kept.

table:iequal.desc: Compares two arrays for equality: first by # length, then element by element (the later of the two definitions wins).

table:size.desc: Counts the keys reachable via pairs and returns the count.

math.round.desc: Rounds a number: without idp it returns an integer; with idp it formats via '%.Nf' and returns a string.

math.mix.desc: Linear interpolation between x and y with factor a: y*a + x*(1-a).

IsTweakMode.desc: Returns widgetHandler.tweakMode, telling whether the UI is currently in tweak (layout edit) mode.

unpack4.desc: Returns t[1]..t[4]; when t is nil it returns 1,2,3,4 (usually used to unpack {x,y,w,h}).

clamp.desc: Clamps num into the [min, max] range and returns it.

ExpandRect.desc: Expands rect={x,y,w,h} outwards by margin={left,top,right,bottom} and returns the new rect table.

InRect.desc: Returns whether point (x, y) lies inside the rect (borders included).

ProcessRelativeCoord.desc: Converts a relative coordinate to pixels: a string is a percentage (e.g. "50%"), a negative number is an offset from total, anything else is floored.

params.code: coordinate (number, percentage string or negative number)

IsRelativeCoord.desc: Returns whether the coordinate is relative: true for strings and for negative numbers.

IsRelativeCoordType.desc: Returns the coordinate type string: "relative" (string), "negative" (negative number) or "default".

IsObject.desc: Returns whether the value is a Chili object (metatable/userdata type carrying a classname field).

IsNumber.desc: Returns whether the value is of type number.

isnumber.desc: Returns whether the value is of type number (lowercase alias of IsNumber).

istable.desc: Returns whether the value is of type table.

isstring.desc: Returns whether the value is of type string.

isindexable.desc: Returns whether the value is indexable (table, metatable or userdata).

isfunc.desc: Returns whether the value is of type function.

PushScissor.desc: Intersects the rect with the current scissor area, pushes it and calls gl.Scissor; returns false when the area is empty so nothing renders.

PopScissor.desc: Pops the scissor stack and restores the previous area; when the stack is empty it calls gl.Scissor(false) to turn clipping off.

AreRectsOverlapping.desc: Returns whether two rects overlap (touching borders count as overlapping).

print.desc: Wraps the native print and calls io.flush() afterwards so output is flushed immediately.

_ParseColorArgs.desc: Returns r as-is when it is a table, otherwise returns {r, g, b, a}. (internal)

CreateWeakTable.desc: Creates a weak-value table (__mode='v') whose values may be garbage collected.

InvertColor.desc: Inverts a color: each RGB channel becomes 1-c, alpha is kept.

mulColor.desc: Multiplies the RGB channels by scalar s, keeping alpha.

mulColors.desc: Multiplies two colors channel by channel (alpha included).

mixColors.desc: Interpolates two colors channel by channel with factor a via math.mix.

incolor2color.desc: Parses an engine in-color string (3 RGB bytes after the first byte) into r,g,b (0..1) and alpha=1.

fileDesc: General-purpose helpers: relative-coordinate and color conversion, rectangles and the scissor stack, type checks, plus string/table/math extensions.
